name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Frosted And Mirror Acrylic Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality 2-layer acrylic, combining a frosted acrylic base layer with a mirror acrylic accent layer for a stylish and elegant look.
    - The Layer 1 frosted acrylic creates a soft, modern background that enhances the printed design.
    - The Layer 2 mirror acrylic adds a luxurious reflective effect and engraved decorative detail.
    - Each acrylic layer has a thickness of 3mm, giving the sign a sturdy and premium construction.
    - Designed with a custom shape silhouette, making it suitable for weddings, events, welcome signs, and personalized décor.
    - Available mirror acrylic finishes:
              +) Gold Mirror Acrylic
              +) Silver Mirror Acrylic 
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in the following W x H sizes:
              +) 6 x 8 in ~ 15.24 x 20.32 cm
              +) 8 x 12 in ~ 20.32 x 30.48 cm
              +) 12 x 18 in ~ 30.48 x 45.72 cm
              +) 18 x 24 in ~ 45.72 x 60.96 cm
              +) 24 x 36 in ~ 60.96 x 91.44 cm
              +) 30 x 30 in ~ 76.2 x 76.2 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed. 
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV 1-sided printing on the frosted acrylic layer to produce clear details, elegant colors, and a smooth professional finish.
    - The mirror acrylic layer is finished with engraving for a clean and sophisticated decorative effect.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as a personalized decorative sign for weddings, parties, events, and special occasions.
    - Perfect for modern wedding décor, engagement parties, anniversary events, bridal showers, receptions, and personalized home décor.
    - Creates a refined decorative statement while keeping the design personalized and memorable.
    - Designed to enhance the atmosphere of an event with a stylish and elegant presentation.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for couples, newlyweds, family members, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for weddings, anniversaries, engagements, bridal showers, and housewarming occasions.
    - Ideal as both an event decoration and a meaningful keepsake after the celebration.
    - Makes a memorable decorative piece for displaying special names, dates, and personal messages.
    - A beautiful custom gift that combines elegance, sentiment, and lasting value 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Frosted And Mirror Acrylic Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
